title: Brazilian-Style Roast Beef with Aromatics
description: A flavorful and savory keto roast beef dish with aromatic vegetables, perfect for a low-carb dinner.

ingredients.name: Aromatics (onion, garlic, and bell pepper)
ingredients.amount: 1 large onion, 3 cloves garlic, 2 bell peppers

ingredients.name: Brazilian spices (cumin, coriander, and chili powder)

instructions: Season the roast beef with salt, Brazilian spices, and olive oil, rubbing it evenly.
In a large Dutch oven, sear the roast beef over medium-high heat until browned on all sides.
Remove the roast beef and set it aside.
Add the chopped aromatics to the pot and cook until they start to soften.
Return the roast beef to the pot, cover it with a lid, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef in the oven for 2-3 hours or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the roast beef rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with the aromatic vegetables and enjoy!
